2082 Chaitra 22, Sunday
11:00 AM
Election of the Speaker
Honorable Rabi Lamichhane will present the following proposal:-
"That Honorable Member of Parliament Dol Prasad Aryal be elected to the post of Speaker."
This proposal will be supported by Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam, Honorable Minister of Finance Swarnim Wagle, and Honorable Minister of Physical Infrastructure and Transport and Minister of Urban Development Sunil Lamsal.
Padma Prasad Pandey
General Secretary

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The meeting commenced with the election of the Speaker. Honorable Rabi Lamichhane proposed Dol Prasad Aryal for the position. The proposal was seconded by the Ministers of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Finance, and Physical Infrastructure and Transport.
